context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature gating is fully implemented and working. The useEnterpriseAccess hook fetches feature access from /api/admin/feature-access endpoint. Starter plan gets basic features only, Professional adds loan management features, Enterprise adds team/credit/document features. UI testing is challenging due to React Native Web session management - sessions are lost on direct URL navigation. Use in-app navigation or API verification for testing.
